sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室》女士。

sentences.en: Oh, hi.
sentences.zh: 噢，嗨。

sentences.en: Welcome, everyone, to a breakdown of Lotto.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家收听本期《彩票》的解析。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Are you guys ready to get lucky?
sentences.zh: 你们准备好走运了吗？

sentences.en: It's Season 8, Episode 3.
sentences.zh: 这是第八季第三集。

sentences.en: It was written by Charlie Grandy, directed by John Krasinski, and was an episode that received a solid B rating from reviewer Miles McNutt.
sentences.zh: 本集由查理·格兰迪编剧，约翰·卡拉辛斯基执导，评论家迈尔斯·麦克纳特给这一集打出了B的稳健评分。

sentences.en: Way to go.
sentences.zh: 干得好。

sentences.en: Would you like a summary?
sentences.zh: 需要我来总结一下剧情吗？

sentences.en: You know I would.
sentences.zh: 你知道我肯定想听。

sentences.en: When the warehouse crew win the lottery and quit their jobs, the upstairs employees are left to pick up the slack until a new crew can be hired.
sentences.zh: 当仓库员工中了彩票并辞职后，楼上的员工不得不接手他们的工作，直到招募到新员工为止。

sentences.en: Aaron, Jim, Dwight, and Kevin can't seem to figure out how to load boxes of paper into a delivery truck.
sentences.zh: 亚伦、吉姆、德怀特和凯文似乎搞不定怎么把纸箱装进货车里。

sentences.en: It takes them all day.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一整天时间。

sentences.en: And then they don't even finish.
sentences.zh: 结果还没干完。

sentences.en: All day.
sentences.zh: 整整一天。

sentences.en: And not just all day, but they become like Wile E.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们还像威利狼一样，

sentences.en: Coyote trying to build some kind of device to load them.
sentences.zh: 试图制造某种装置来装货。

sentences.en: It's just, it's bonkers.
sentences.zh: 简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: In the meantime, a very depressed Daryl issues an ultimatum to Andy.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，非常沮丧的达里尔向安迪下了最后通牒。

sentences.en: He says, fire me or make me manager.
sentences.zh: 他说，要么解雇我，要么让我当经理。

sentences.en: And then the rest of the gang fantasize about what they would do if they had win the lottery, which causes a little friction between Pam and Jim.
sentences.zh: 剩下的伙伴们开始幻想如果自己中了彩票会做什么，这导致帕姆和吉姆之间产生了一些摩擦。

sentences.en: They have dueling fantasies.
sentences.zh: 他们有着截然不同的幻想。

sentences.en: Yeah, they don't get along in their fantasy lives.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他们在幻想生活中也合不来。

sentences.en: They don't.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Which normally you would think that your marriage is even better and stronger in your fantasy life, but not so.
sentences.zh: 通常你会认为在幻想生活中，婚姻会变得更好更稳固，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Or in your fantasy life, is it more clear because you have options?
sentences.zh: 还是说在幻想生活中，因为你有更多选择，所以反而看得更清楚了？

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: That's a very like therapist-y thing to say, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你这话听起来真像个心理治疗师。

sentences.en: I like that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个说法。

sentences.en: I love that thought.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个想法。

sentences.en: Journal on that, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家可以把这个写进日记里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, listen, we don't have any fast facts today because instead we have an amazing interview with Mark Brooks, who plays Nate, who is featured in this episode,
sentences.zh: 听着，今天我们没有快讯环节，因为我们准备了一段非常棒的采访，嘉宾是饰演内特的马克·布鲁克斯，他不仅在本集中有精彩表现，

sentences.en: but who also appears in 19 episodes of The Office, spanning three seasons.
sentences.zh: 而且在《办公室》的三季中总共出演了19集。

sentences.en: We can't be more excited for you to hear this interview.
sentences.zh: 我们迫不及待想让你们听到这段采访了。

sentences.en: He's an absolute delight of a person.
sentences.zh: 他本人绝对是个讨人喜欢的人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We have wanted to talk to him for a while, and this is not the last time we're talking to him because we have more to ask Mark about as the seasons progress.
sentences.zh: 我们想找他聊天已经很久了，而且这不会是我们最后一次采访他，因为随着剧集推进，我们还有更多问题要问马克。

sentences.en: And I know that we always say that everybody is so nice and amazing, but I think you're going to hear in this interview that Mark is like at the top.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们总说每个人都很好、很棒，但我相信听完这段采访你会觉得，马克绝对是顶尖的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's the beSt.
sentences.zh: 他是最棒的。

sentences.en: He's 100% real deal.
sentences.zh: 他百分之百是个真诚的人。

sentences.en: And here you go.
sentences.zh: 那么，请听。

sentences.en: Here's our conversation with Mark.
sentences.zh: 这是我们与马克（Mark）的对话。

sentences.en: Mark, hello.
sentences.zh: 马克，你好。

sentences.en: Welcome to Office, ladies.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《办公室》节目，女士们。

sentences.en: Thank you guys for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Well, we are so excited to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 我们也非常高兴能和你聊天。

sentences.en: We are really enjoying Nate, and Nate had some real fun stuff coming up, and we just know the fans can't wait to hear from you.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很喜欢内特（Nate）这个角色，内特接下来还有一些非常有趣的戏份，我们知道粉丝们都迫不及待想听你分享了。

sentences.en: Well, that's exciting.
sentences.zh: 那太令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: I've been waiting a long time to get my chance to talk on Office, ladies, so here we go.
sentences.zh: 我等了很久才等到机会在《办公室》节目里聊聊，女士们，所以我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Well, Mark, when your character was introduced, we told a little bit of your origin story, but I just want you to tell it again in your own words from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 马克，当你的角色刚出场时，我们简单介绍过你的背景故事，但我还是想请你用自己的话从头讲一遍。

sentences.en: This is our favorite question to ask our guests.
sentences.zh: 这是我们最喜欢问嘉宾的问题。

sentences.en: How did you get your job on the office?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得到《办公室》这份工作的？

sentences.en: I quite honestly backed into it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我是误打误撞进来的。

sentences.en: I was unemployed, living in Wisconsin, in Milwaukee, and I had this idea to make my friends laugh, which was go on morning news shows as a character,
sentences.zh: 当时我失业了，住在威斯康星州的密尔沃基，我有个点子想逗朋友们开心，就是以一个角色的身份去上早间新闻节目，

sentences.en: and a character that would be inept and clumsy.
sentences.zh: 一个笨拙又无能的角色。

sentences.en: But the main thing was that the anchors and the news station had no idea I was in character.
sentences.zh: 但最关键的是，那些主播和新闻台根本不知道我在演戏。

sentences.en: Now, I had never taken acting classes or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 我从来没上过表演课之类的东西。

sentences.en: I just thought it would be funny, and so I would go on these morning shows as this yo-yo master, which is funny.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这会很有趣，于是我就以“溜溜球大师”的身份去上这些早间节目，这本身就挺逗的。

sentences.en: Kay Strass, the yo-yo master, who was not a master of the yo-yo.
sentences.zh: 凯·斯特劳斯（K-Strauss），溜溜球大师，但他其实根本不会玩溜溜球。

sentences.en: No, because I can't yo-yo.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为我根本不会玩溜溜球。

sentences.en: I'm not even a big fan of yo-yoing.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不是溜溜球的粉丝。

sentences.en: And so I would get on and start rambling about my chaotic personal life, and finally they would ask me to do a demonstration, and that would go horribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以我就上节目，开始胡言乱语地讲我那混乱的私生活，最后他们会让我演示一下，然后事情就会变得一团糟。

sentences.en: The idea was to do 10 or 11 or 12 of these, and if you watched them all in a row, you would get this kind of strange story arc about this guy's life, all told through two-minute,
sentences.zh: 我的想法是做10到12期这样的节目，如果你把它们连起来看，就会发现这个人的生活有一条奇怪的故事线，全都是通过早间节目里两分钟、

sentences.en: one-minute segments on morning shows.
sentences.zh: 一分钟的片段讲述出来的。

sentences.en: Now, I have to stop you because you're saying you never took any acting classes.
sentences.zh: 我得打断你一下，因为你说你从来没上过表演课。

sentences.en: Did you take, like, improv or sketch comedy?
sentences.zh: 那你上过即兴表演或小品喜剧课吗？

sentences.en: No?
sentences.zh: 没有吗？

sentences.en: No, I never did any of that.
sentences.zh: 没有，我从来没做过那些。

sentences.en: It's like a writing class, because there is a real story arc there.
sentences.zh: 这就像写作课一样，因为里面确实有一条完整的故事线。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's, no, you know, all that was just myself wanting to do this.
sentences.zh: 是啊，不，你知道，那全都是我自己想这么做的。

sentences.en: I'm so fascinated by this.
sentences.zh: 我对这个太着迷了。

sentences.en: I always have been.
sentences.zh: 我一直都很着迷。

sentences.en: I've made you tell me this story so many times, because every time, it just blows my mind.
sentences.zh: 我让你讲过很多次这个故事了，因为每次听，我都觉得不可思议。

sentences.en: Okay, so I'll let you go on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你继续讲。

sentences.en: Okay, so I did these appearances, and like I said,
sentences.zh: 好的，我做了这些亮相，就像我说的，

sentences.en: the idea was to do 10, 11, 12, and to get a story arc,
sentences.zh: 我的想法是做10到12期，形成一条故事线，

sentences.en: and what I didn't expect was for people to start posting them on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 但我没想到人们会开始把它们发到YouTube上。

sentences.en: And this was back in 2010, and so there were still videos that could really catch fire and become viral.
sentences.zh: 那是2010年的事了，那时候视频确实很容易火起来，成为病毒式传播的内容。

sentences.en: And the K-Strauss morning show appearances became viral.
sentences.zh: 于是凯·斯特劳斯的早间节目亮相就火了。

sentences.en: And at first, I was really annoyed, because I was like, well, they've ruined my opportunity here to tell, like, this story arc I want to tell.
sentences.zh: 起初我真的很恼火，因为我觉得，好吧，他们毁了我原本想讲的那个故事线的机会。

sentences.en: Because I had no idea of, you know, coming to L.A., coming to Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时根本没想过要来洛杉矶，来好莱坞。

sentences.en: And oddly enough, a friend of mine got a text message from one of the writers on the show,
sentences.zh: 但奇怪的是，我的一位朋友收到了该剧编剧发来的一条短信，

sentences.en: and she figured out who I was through computer sleuthing and what have you.
sentences.zh: 她通过网络搜索之类的手段查出了我的身份。

sentences.en: And she asked if I, you know, would I want to talk to Paul Lieberstein, who was running the show.
sentences.zh: 她问我愿不愿意和当时负责该剧的保罗·利伯斯坦（Paul Lieberstein）聊聊。

sentences.en: And I was like, yeah, of course I would.
sentences.zh: 我说，当然愿意。

sentences.en: And a few minutes later, Paul calls me.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，保罗就给我打了电话。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, I'm talking to Toby from the office.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我就在和《办公室》里的托比（Toby）通话了。

sentences.en: And a month later, they flew me out.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，他们就让我飞过去了。

sentences.en: I met with the writers.
sentences.zh: 我和编剧们见了面。

sentences.en: And a month after that, I was on the show.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，我就上了那个节目。

sentences.en: I mean, that's crazy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: The real crazy thing here.
sentences.zh: 真正疯狂的是这个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: The writer that reached out was my now wife, Amelie Gillette, who had just started writing on the show a couple weeks before all this blew up.
sentences.zh: 当时联系我的编剧就是我现在的妻子，Amelie Gillette，她在这一切爆发前几周才刚开始为该剧写剧本。

sentences.en: So you got an arc on the office and a wife out of this.
sentences.zh: 所以你不仅在《办公室》里有了戏份，还因此收获了一位妻子。

sentences.en: The yo-yo.
sentences.zh: 溜溜球。

sentences.en: The yo-yo idea that was just meant to entertain your friends.
sentences.zh: 那个本意只是为了逗朋友开心的溜溜球点子。

sentences.en: It's an incredible story.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个不可思议的故事。

sentences.en: You know, you don't hear too many stories like this anymore.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在很少能听到这样的故事了。

sentences.en: You know, it's usually, oh, I was working for 12, 15 years.
sentences.zh: 通常都是说，哦，我努力工作了12年、15年。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, I started in commercials and what have you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从拍广告之类的开始做起。

sentences.en: And I feel kind of guilty because it was kind of overnight almoSt.
sentences.zh: 我感到有点内疚，因为这几乎是一夜成名。

sentences.en: But I'm so grateful that it all happened.
sentences.zh: 但我非常感激这一切的发生。

sentences.en: I got so much out of just making a jackass of myself on morning news.
sentences.zh: 我在早间新闻里出尽洋相，却从中收获良多。

sentences.en: So you had seen The Office before you got cast, obviously.
sentences.zh: 所以你显然在参演之前就看过《办公室》了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，看过。

sentences.en: What was it like to walk on to the set?
sentences.zh: 第一次走进片场是什么感觉？

sentences.en: You know, the first person I met from the cast was Rain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我见到的第一位演员是Rain。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 而且。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: I can't imagine what that was like.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象那是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Now, you guys can say that because he is the sweetest, nicest, most genuine person.
sentences.zh: 现在你们可以这么说，因为他是个最贴心、最友善、最真诚的人。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: He's just a good, good soul.
sentences.zh: 他真的是个很好很好的人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so, you know, it could have gone to one of two ways.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当时情况可能会有两种走向。

sentences.en: And after now I've been acting for, you know, quite a few years now.
sentences.zh: 到现在我已经演戏，你知道，也有好几年了。

sentences.en: You know, I and I've as a guest star have gone on many shows, the cast is either welcoming or they can be a little cold and a little distance because here comes a new face.
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为客串演员，我去过很多剧组，演员们要么很热情，要么会有点冷淡和疏离，因为来了个新面孔。

sentences.en: And that's time away from you as an actor and your character.
sentences.zh: 那意味着会分走你作为演员和角色本身的时间。

sentences.en: Or you can just, you know, a high tide lifts all boats type scenario where they're happy that there's fresh people coming in.
sentences.zh: 或者也可以是那种“水涨船高”的情况，他们很高兴有新人加入。

sentences.en: And you guys were so nice and welcoming to me.
sentences.zh: 而你们对我真的非常友善和热情。

sentences.en: I really got spoiled coming into the show because of that, because you guys were so nice and welcoming.
sentences.zh: 因为你们的友善和热情，我刚进剧组时真的被宠坏了。

sentences.en: And what a first show to cut your teeth on as an actor.
sentences.zh: 而且作为一名演员，能以这部剧作为磨练演技的起点，真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, everyone was so generous and encouraging from the top down.
sentences.zh: 我是说，从上到下，每个人都非常慷慨和鼓励我。

sentences.en: It was I look back on it and I was so lucky.
sentences.zh: 回首往事，我觉得自己太幸运了。

sentences.en: So very, very fortunate.
sentences.zh: 真的非常、非常幸运。

sentences.en: Well, you know, this episode we're breaking down is the lotto, but we all felt like we won the lottery ticket, you know, the minute we were caSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们这集拆解的是《彩票》那一集，但我们每个人都觉得，从被选中的那一刻起，我们就已经中了彩票。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So I love hearing that because that's how we felt on set.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴听到这些，因为我们在片场也是这种感觉。

sentences.en: We were just really happy to be there and counted ourselves lucky every day.
sentences.zh: 我们只是很高兴能待在那里，每天都觉得自己很幸运。

sentences.en: But, Mark, we wanted to ask you if you have any favorite memories or behind the scene moment or anything you would want to share from your time on the show.
sentences.zh: 但是，Mark，我们想问问你，在剧组期间有没有什么最喜欢的记忆、幕后花絮或者任何你想分享的事情？

sentences.en: Gosh, there's so many.
sentences.zh: 天哪，太多了。

sentences.en: You know, any time I could get one of you guys to break, I was a feather in my cap, especially as, you know, a person just starting out in acting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，任何时候只要能让你们其中一个人笑场，对我来说都是一种成就，尤其是作为一个刚入行的新人演员。

sentences.en: I felt like, you know, there was a scene I remember with Jenna where she's grilling me.
sentences.zh: 我记得有场戏是Jenna在盘问我。

sentences.en: And I think it was in season nine, vandalism.
sentences.zh: 我想是在第九季的《破坏公物》那一集。

sentences.en: We're down in the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我们在仓库里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's one of my strongest memories of breaking.
sentences.zh: 这是我关于笑场最深刻的记忆之一。

sentences.en: And we just had so much fun.
sentences.zh: 我们当时玩得太开心了。

sentences.en: And it's such a fond memory for me that that moment, you know, the first day on the show or my first time ever in front of a set in front of a crew filming.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说是一段非常美好的回忆，你知道，那是节目拍摄的第一天，也是我第一次在片场面对剧组进行拍摄。

sentences.en: Um, I had to knock down a beehive that was in front of the office.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当时得去捅掉办公室门前的一个蜂窝。

sentences.en: Yeah.
